input.summary: Applied the two verified findings from the gate report. The figure briefs no longer verbalize a position for the indexing rib and mating channel on the spacer frame (removing the centreline placement in FIG. 2 and the "upper web" placement over the air-dividing space in FIG. 3), and the untraced negative attribute about electrical power, batteries, and logging devices was deleted from the mechanical exposure indicator section. Nothing else was touched: claims, numeral table, drawing descriptions, and all other briefs remain byte for byte as approved. The FIG. 3 brief still shows the rib engaged in the channel and the channel bounded on both sides by frame material, so the disclosed registration function is unchanged; the brief edits will be re-rendered and re-inspected by the drawing pipeline. Note that no prior-art search was run for this application, so the art on file may be incomplete.
changes: figures/FIG-2.md: removed "at the centre of the width" from the depending tongue description in the Insulated lid 60 bullet, so no position across the module is verbalized for the registration joint.

figures/FIG-3.md: changed the Mating channel 52 bullet from "an upwardly open recess in the upper web of the frame 42" to "an upwardly open recess in an upper surface of the frame 42", removing the undisclosed relationship between the channel and the roof of the space between the opposed cassettes.
figures/FIG-3.md: changed the closing statement to "the lid 60 lies above the frame 42", removing the remaining "upper web" reference.
draft/08-detailed-description.md: deleted the trailing clause asserting that no electrical power, battery, or logging device is required for the indication, which traced to no inventor passage.

patches.replace: an unnumbered short tongue depending from its underside into an unnumbered recess in the upper surface of the module 40
patches.why: Removes the undisclosed centreline position of the registration joint; the disclosure states only that the rib enters a mating channel in the spacer frame.

patches.find: Mating channel 52: an upwardly open recess in the upper web of the frame 42, shown schematically and bounded on both sides by hatched frame material.
patches.replace: Mating channel 52: an upwardly open recess in an upper surface of the frame 42, shown schematically and bounded on both sides by hatched frame material.
patches.why: Removes the undisclosed placement of the channel in the web closing the plenum between the opposed cassettes, while keeping the disclosed rib-and-channel engagement.

patches.find: The rib 62 is engaged in the channel 52 while the lid 60 lies above the upper web of the frame 42.
patches.replace: The rib 62 is engaged in the channel 52 while the lid 60 lies above the frame 42.
patches.why: Removes the remaining reference to the upper web, which located the joint over the air-dividing space.

patches.find: the reserve that actually conditions the payload, and no electrical power, battery, or logging device is required for the indication.
patches.replace: the reserve that actually conditions the payload.
patches.why: Deletes the untraced comparative attribute about power, batteries, and logging devices, which appears in no inventor passage.

content.text: I confined the repair to the two figure briefs, exactly as the finding directs; no application text changes were needed since the description, claims, and numeral table are already silent on any wall penetration.

input.summary: The single verified finding was that figures/FIG-2.md and figures/FIG-7.md verbalized a horizontal bore through the insulated shell side wall with the indicator stem lying in it and traversing the wall thickness — a through-wall topology the inventor never disclosed. I removed the bore and through-wall language from both briefs and replaced it with the neutral relationship the disclosure does support: the indicator is at the outer face of the shell side wall, visible from outside, with the stem extending inward and thermally coupled to one phase-change cassette, the intervening structure omitted for clarity. No aperture, passage, sleeve, or thermal-bridge geometry was substituted. The application text (title, field, summary, drawing descriptions, detailed description, claims, abstract, numeral table) is untouched, byte for byte: it was already neutral on this point, and the numerals shown on FIG. 2 and FIG. 7 are unchanged, so the numeral table, drawing descriptions, and briefs remain synchronized. The drawing pipeline will render and inspect fresh pixels for FIG. 2 and FIG. 7 from the corrected briefs; no rendered artifact was edited.
changes: figures/FIG-2.md: removed ", with a bore through that wall" from the shell side wall bullet, leaving the indicator assembly shown schematically at the outer face of the left shell side wall 14.
figures/FIG-7.md: deleted the sentence describing a horizontal bore through the thickness of shell side wall 14 from the "Shell side wall 14" bullet.
figures/FIG-7.md: rewrote the "Indicator stem 82" bullet so the stem extends inward from the indicator 80 rather than lying in a bore.

figures/FIG-7.md: rewrote the first closing statement so the stem extends inward from the indicator at the outer surface of the wall and is thermally coupled to cassette 44, with the structure between the shell side wall 14 and that cassette omitted for clarity, dropping the through-the-wall-thickness and inner-end-at-the-inner-side assertions.
No change made to draft/ files: the claims, detailed description, drawing descriptions, numeral table, and abstract already stated no wall penetration and remain byte for byte identical.

patches.find: The indicator assembly is shown schematically at the outer face of the left shell side wall 14, with a bore through that wall.
patches.replace: The indicator assembly is shown schematically at the outer face of the left shell side wall 14.
patches.why: The disclosure supports only an indicator visible from outside; it never discloses a bore or any passage through the insulated shell wall. Removing the bore keeps the brief to disclosed substance.

patches.find: - Shell side wall 14: an upright hatched slab of substantial thickness running the full height of the view, with an outer surface facing left and an inner surface facing right. A horizontal bore passes through its thickness, drawn as a blank passage between two hatched wall portions.
patches.replace: - Shell side wall 14: an upright hatched slab of substantial thickness running the full height of the view, with an outer surface facing left and an inner surface facing right.
patches.why: Deletes the undisclosed horizontal bore through the insulating envelope; no substitute aperture or passage geometry is introduced.

patches.find: - Indicator stem 82: an elongate bar lying in the bore, drawn with its own outline and its own hatching pattern distinct from that of the shell side wall 14.
patches.replace: - Indicator stem 82: an elongate bar extending inward from the indicator 80, drawn with its own outline and its own hatching pattern distinct from that of the shell side wall 14.
patches.why: The stem-in-bore fit is undisclosed technical substance; the stem is described only by its disclosed relationships (part of the indicator, thermally coupled to a cassette).

patches.find: - The stem 82 extends from the indicator 80 at the outer surface of the shell side wall 14 through the thickness of that wall, its inner end lying at the inner side of the shell side wall 14 and being thermally coupled to the cassette 44 shown at the right of the view, the intervening structure being omitted.
patches.replace: - The stem 82 extends inward from the indicator 80 at the outer surface of the shell side wall 14 and is thermally coupled to the cassette 44 shown at the right of the view, the structure between the shell side wall 14 and that cassette 44 being omitted for clarity.
patches.why: Removes the assertion that the stem traverses the wall thickness with an inner end at the inner side of the wall, retaining only the disclosed thermal coupling to one phase-change cassette and the omission-for-clarity note that matches draft/07-drawings.md.
